description: Navigate the active or specified tab to a new URL, or perform history/reload actions ('back', 'forward', 'reload'). Supports initScript, ignoreCache, handleBeforeUnload, and includeSnapshot.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

handleBeforeUnload.description: Automatically accept or decline beforeunload confirmation dialogs during navigation

ignoreCache.description: Bypass browser cache when action is 'reload' (default: false)

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after navigation completes (default: false)

initScript.description: Optional JavaScript registered via Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument before navigating

password.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password (automatically URL-encoded into the destination URL)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after navigation

url.description: Destination URL (required when action is 'url' or omitted)

username.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username (automatically URL-encoded into the destination URL)

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after navigation

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after navigation

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after navigation

waitUntil.description: Wait for tab load completion before returning (default: true)
